summary: Control de Visitas end-to-end testing (iteration 12). 10 backend pytest cases (permissions, CRUD, kiosk-pending, selfie capture) all pass. Frontend flows verified: admin sidebar shows both visits entries; employee without perms hides them, and after admin toggles perms via API + re-login the entries appear. Agendar Visita form validates missing host, supports personal/laboral tab switching, add/remove visitors, and successful submission toasts 'Visita agendada correctamente'. Histórico page renders filter controls (from/to/type/search), lists visits with Personal (emerald) / Laboral badges, detail dialog opens with visitor cards; the 'Imprimir / Exportar' button only appears when the visit has at least one captured selfie (verified with the laboral 2-selfie visit created by backend tests).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1913 lines — should be split into routers (users/visits/kiosk/reports) for maintainability.
POST /visits accepts payload.scheduled_at from the client with no bound check; a caller could backdate/postdate arbitrarily. Consider min/max validation.

POST /visits/{visit_id}/capture-selfie is unauthenticated (like the kiosk pending endpoint). This is intentional per the review note, but a rate-limit or a per-visit short-lived token would harden it against selfie flooding.
GET /visits limits to 500 with no pagination — will silently truncate history once dataset grows.
AgendarVisitaPage: host Select renders 138 options (all users) with no search — should switch to a Combobox with type-ahead for usability.
